problems.symptom: A producer writes a field, id, shape name or envelope that its consumer does not read, so the join silently returns empty.
problems.root_cause: There is no contract seam between writers and readers, and no detector for the class. Each instance was patched locally.

problems.symptom: reached:true for work that did not happen: contentless fetch, rolled-back edit, relative-path write, satisfier artefacts, method-shared recompute.
problems.root_cause: Reach is decided at many independent return sites (31 'reached: true,' in one file) and an LLM judge checks form, not value.

problems.symptom: Commits land green but inert, wrong-function, zero-caller or partial (3/3 insertions inert, observer reading nonexistent fields).
problems.root_cause: Grading keys on a landed sha, not on the requested effect. Gates are structural, not semantic.

problems.symptom: Gaps are born without edit_site or falsifier, decompose children echo the parent truncated at 400 chars, and the summary is frozen so a retry is the same try.
problems.root_cause: Goal-text shredding plus lineage by copying prose. 783 gaps have falsifier:none.

problems.symptom: -narrowed/recommit children multiply, burn the single compose slot, and launder the hopeless() attempt counter.
problems.root_cause: The child id resets failed_attempts. Closed and narrowed gaps keep composing.

problems.symptom: Gap closures are mostly TTL expiry or instant no-op closes. Repair-verified is 1.9-4.5%. close_basis is written on 0.5% and resolution on 3%.
problems.root_cause: gap_lifecycle_scan is the dominant closer, overwrites detected_at, uses a 120h TTL while claiming 336h, and closed_by_trace is written by nothing.

problems.symptom: Categories sealed (orphaned_capability 346/0, 13 sealed). The only escape (a human answer) never converts. 248 escalations were unanswered.
problems.root_cause: hopeless() reads the calibration file, and provide_information writes no field compose reads.

problems.symptom: Learning does not compound: 74% of arms have n=1, Spearman is about 0, improvements are step functions from bug fixes.
problems.root_cause: Evidence per arm is 11x short. Views grade on exit status. Arm grading ignores reach. The router is degenerate and the boredom pin sits outside selection.

problems.symptom: The self-development lane's executions are never graded (868/873), and a successful self-repair banked 0 labels.
problems.root_cause: activity-api mints exec_ ids, and the void fetch discards the id while the reach verdict is keyed feature_compose:<sha>.

problems.symptom: Anchors are invented or mislocalized to early prominent lines, and the planner picks non-unique anchors.
problems.root_cause: Information starvation: god files of 10-16k lines, a rg-dependent symbol list with rg absent, region grounding dead, lessons unreachable on the spoke.

problems.symptom: Fixes land but do not run: mirror without restart, three trees per vessel, detached HEADs, dirty clones blocking pull-sync.
problems.root_cause: The deploy topology has several copies, and pull-sync defers or never restarts.

problems.symptom: Federated nodes silently lack capabilities: 42 autonomy units masked, concept-db port unpublished, hub dev-vessel with separate gap/memory state, spoke registry drained.
problems.root_cause: Role groups and per-node deploy drift. Placement is not verified by a cross-node reach detector.

problems.symptom: Redial storms, one-way hub-to-spoke import of 0, phantom reservations, relay lost in migration.
problems.root_cause: NO_RESERVATION misattribution, SELF_MIRROR early return, and a relay living on the host outside volumes.

problems.symptom: Pinned loopback endpoints (ribosome LLM, CONCEPT_DB_ENDPOINT), wrong envelopes, dead discovery rows giving 0-byte grounding.
problems.root_cause: Raw endpoint constants bypass discovery, and there is no rogue-registrant detection.

problems.symptom: Substrate landings broke builds and features (5697f70, 0f794d2, 2fe3750, 9775bc8, 3130a55 clobber, 8340f57 stale-base overwrite).

principles: A health probe must do representative work; RETURN 1 cannot detect congestion. [db-congestion 08-08]
Test a routing change from the caller's side, not the server's. [deadvertise 08-03]
A learning channel that can only append to the prompt cannot fix a defect that lives in the prompt. [decomposition-echoes 09-05]
Many attempts and zero lands means reading the SPEC for a guaranteed-failure clause. Put the helper and its call site in the same goal. [09-05]
A total of exactly zero is a broken probe. Run the probe against a target whose answer you already know. [09-05, 08-10]
A recovery counter that increments forever is a mask. Poll the artifact, not the status field. [dev-vessel-stalls 09-11]
A unique anchor supplied is not a unique anchor used. Read the diff; reason strings mix provenance. [09-11]
Ask which tree a consumer reads: runtime /vessels, deploy clone, or submodule pointer. [07-26, 08-09]
Verify a push by asking the remote, never by exit code. git push from a detached HEAD pushes nothing. [08-06, 08-10]
Autonomy of landing is not autonomy of correct effect. In-place modifications succeed; insertions land inert. [08-13]
Ask the consumer, not the store. A correct control on the wrong instance proves nothing. [08-12]
Check the advertised spelling before concluding a capability is absent. Check X is not merely unexpressed in the transport vocabulary before calling it impossible. [08-19]
What improves is what gets fixed; nothing improves by accumulating evidence. Learning without alternatives is bookkeeping. [09-05, 09-06]
Measure a competition claim at the unit the selector actually selects over. [09-06]
When learned selection is stuck, check for a NaN or degenerate argmax before theorizing about posteriors. [07-31]
Never hardcode which model. Select willing and capable via shaped selection; location must not matter. [operator ruling 07-31]
A category-count finding is only as good as a read of the category's members. [08-10]
Repair the wire before authoring content. Do not dispatch drafter fixes through the drafter. [08-04]
An edge-liveness state names a place to look, not a culprit. [08-09]
Reach granted for routing is not reach for effect. A fix that lowers reported reach is correct when it removes false credit. Pre-register the observable. [09-12]
An empty grep result is not a zero. Check landability before filing, and clean up your own filings. [09-13]
A gate must test the row's own proposition, not one its ancestry implies. [08-06]
A chain of individually honest components can be end-to-end dishonest. The evidence is an asymmetry. [escape-valve 08-29]
Verify the floor by ablating the cache. [eval-harness 07-26]
Behaviour steered by env or constants makes the system un-evaluable; control must be per-dispatch shapes. [evaluability audit 07-26]
